editorial: Today, the practical success of artificial intelligence systems in archaeological discoveries and their pursuit of physical commonsense in video generation are coming to the fore. The discovery of a Mayan pyramid by Google engineers using NASA data concretely proves the capacity of autonomous agents to analyze complex datasets.

items.title: meta/astryx
items.summary: astryx, shared by Meta, is a fully customizable open-source design system designed for both humans and the AI agents working alongside them. Developed with TypeScript, this system aims to adapt to modern software production processes.

snapshot.description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready. An open source design system that's fully customizable and built for how we build now: by people and the agents working alongside them.

items.title: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis
items.summary: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis is a system that performs stock analysis across multiple markets using large language models (LLMs). The software processes data from various sources and real-time news to provide a decision support dashboard and send automated notifications.

snapshot.description: LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统：多源行情、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送，支持零成本定时运行。 LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with multi-source market data, real-time news, decision dashboard, automated notifications, and cost-free scheduled runs.

items.title: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src
items.summary: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src is a resource repository containing the code and documentation necessary for creating, calibrating, and evaluating modern web development guides. Developed in TypeScript, this project enables the management of guidance content for web standards.

snapshot.description: This repo is the source repository for GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance and includes the code and documentation for authoring, calibrating, and evaluating its contents.

items.title: shadcn/improve
items.summary: shadcn/improve is an agent capability that examines a codebase and creates work plans that can be implemented by lower-cost AI models. Aiming to optimize developers' code review and implementation planning processes, this tool targets planning complex tasks with capable models and executing them with more economical ones.

snapshot.description: Use your most capable model to audit your codebase and write plans for cheaper models to execute. An agent skill that audits any codebase and writes implementation plans for other agents to execute.

items.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.summary: Developed by Addy Osmani, agent-skills offers production-ready engineering skills for AI agents that write code. Prepared in JavaScript, this project aims to help agents perform tasks in software development processes in a more standard and reliable manner.

snapshot.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents. Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.

items.title: vercel-labs/agent-browser
items.summary: agent-browser, developed by Vercel Labs, is a command-line interface (CLI) that provides browser automation for AI agents. This tool makes it possible to read web pages as an accessibility tree and interact with them via the command line.

snapshot.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents. Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell.

items.title: we-promise/sure
items.summary: Developed in Ruby, sure is a personal finance and wealth management application open for everyone to use. The project, which includes a feature that allows users to connect with financial advisors (CFP/CFA), is based on the past work of the Maybe Finance team.

snapshot.description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone). The Maybe Finance (archived/abandoned repo) team spent most of 2021–2022 building a full-featured personal finance and wealth management app. It even included an “Ask an Advisor” feature that connected users with a real CFP/CFA — all included with your subscription.

items.title: homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp
items.summary: ha-mcp allows you to configure and automate the smart home platform Home Assistant with AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT. Integrated via HACS, this tool works with full feature support across all Home Assistant installation types.

snapshot.description: Configure and automate Home Assistant with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants. The recommended way to run ha-mcp is the HA-MCP integration. It installs into Home Assistant through HACS (the built-in Marketplace on Home Assistant 2026.11+), runs the full server in-process, and works on every Home Assistant installation type — Home Assistant OS, Supervised, Container, and Core — with full feature parity.

items.title: openai/codex-security
items.summary: Developed by OpenAI, codex-security offers a command-line interface (CLI) and a software development kit (SDK) designed to find, verify, and remediate security vulnerabilities. Written in TypeScript, this tool aims to automate the process of detecting security weaknesses in software projects.

snapshot.description: OpenAI's Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex-security

items.title: TheAlgorithms/Java
items.summary: TheAlgorithms/Java offers an open-source collection of various algorithms written in the Java programming language. Users can run, edit, or contribute to these algorithms directly via the cloud-based development environment Gitpod.io.

snapshot.description: All Algorithms implemented in Java. You can run and edit the algorithms, or contribute to them using Gitpod.io (a free online development environment) with a single click.

items.title: Google SWE points 48 AI agents at NASA Lidar, finds unmapped Maya pyramid in 72h
items.summary: A software engineer working at Google used 48 AI agents to analyze NASA's lidar (laser scanning) data. This system detected an unmapped Mayan pyramid beneath the forest canopy in less than 72 hours.

snapshot.description: AI agents analyzed NASA lidar data overnight and found a Maya site under the jungle that isn't on any map. Less than 72 hours later, Mexico's INAH replied.

items.title: Scion is back and is going to sell a kei truck in America
items.summary: Toyota's automotive brand Scion has announced its return, stating that it will sell small-sized commercial vehicles such as kei trucks, bicycles, and side-by-side hybrid off-road vehicles in the American market. In its new era, the brand aims to operate with an unconventional product range.

snapshot.description: Toyota's Scion is back and this time it's weird. The new Scion is going to sell a Kei truck in America, plus a bike and a hybrid side-by-side

items.title: Apple has new Mac app coming to make running local AI models easy
items.summary: Apple is working on a new Mac application that makes it easier to run local artificial intelligence models. According to leaked information, the company aims to simplify the process for users to run models on their own devices.

snapshot.description: Leaker Aaron Perris has discovered evidence of a new Mac app in the works at Apple that makes it easy to run local AI models.

items.title: Protecting SSH Keys with macOS Secure Enclave
items.summary: macOS Secure Enclave provides a security layer that protects SSH keys at the hardware level, requiring Touch ID authentication for every use. This method allows SSH keys to be stored using the system's own security architecture without the need for third-party applications.

snapshot.description: How to keep SSH keys in the macOS Secure Enclave, with Touch ID on every use and no third-party apps.

items.title: Six Math Essentials
items.summary: Six Math Essentials, prepared by mathematician Terence Tao, defines six main areas considered fundamental for advanced mathematical studies. This resource summarizes the theoretical infrastructure necessary for those who want to delve deeper into academic disciplines.

items.title: xtools-at/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED-heretic
items.summary: xtools-at/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED-heretic is an artificial intelligence model focused on text generation. Exhibiting a high success rate in GSM8K tests, the model aims to approach the performance of larger models with its 9-billion parameter structure.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. The NVFP4 checkpoint was evaluated on GSM8K four times, and the resulting scores were averaged. Its four-run mean accuracy is 94.50% under vLLM. In the comparison supplied with this release, the 9B student slightly exceeds the reported DeepSeek-V4-Pro teacher result and approaches the Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct reference.

items.title: speridlabs/idol
items.summary: speridlabs/idol is an artificial intelligence tool that creates 3D Gaussian splat models from a single image. By cleaning the background and framing the object, this model produces output in the standard .ply format and runs in under two seconds on consumer-grade graphics cards.

snapshot.description: image-to-3d model. Idol turns one picture of an object into a 3D Gaussian splat. Give it a render, a generated image or a photo: it removes the background, frames the object and generates up to 1,048,576 Gaussians, written as a standard 3DGS .ply. It runs on consumer GPUs, using 7.2 GB of VRAM and can run in under 2 seconds.

items.title: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3-Image
items.summary: Developed by MiniMaxAI, MiniMax-H3-Image is an artificial intelligence model with text-to-image conversion capabilities. The software is offered with application programming interfaces (APIs) that support image editing and prompt expansion functions.

snapshot.description: text-to-image model. API docs: - Text-to-image: EN-docs, CN-docs - Image editing: EN-docs, CN-docs - Prompt expansion: EN-docs, CN-docs

items.title: moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro
items.summary: Developed by Moonshot AI, Kimi-K3.1-Pro is a multimodal artificial intelligence model capable of processing visual and textual data. Trained on top of the Kimi K3 model using large-scale reinforcement learning methods, this model is presented as the first and most capable version of the K3.1 series.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. Kimi K3.1 Pro is an open-weight, natively multimodal agentic model, and our most capable 3T-class model to date. Post-trained from Kimi K3 with large-scale joint reinforcement learning across hundreds of downstream domains, it is the first model in the K3.1 series.

items.title: ricursiveAI/Ripple-65B-Preview
items.summary: Developed by Ricursive Intelligence, Ripple-65B-Preview is a dense Transformer model trained with 12 trillion tokens and supporting a context window of up to 1 million tokens. Scoring 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1 and demonstrating high performance in coding tasks, this model offers an alternative to larger-scale open-weight models.

snapshot.description: Ricursive Intelligence introduces Ripple-65B Preview, a 65B parameter dense Transformer model pretrained on 12 trillion tokens with support for up to 1Mi (1,048,576 tokens) of context. Ripple-65B Preview delivers strong results on agentic coding, scoring 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1 and surpassing significantly-larger US open-weight models such as Reflection Beam 501B (80.1), Meta Muse Spark Open…

items.title: PhyRubric: Rubric-Grounded Diagnostic Evaluation of Physical Commonsense in Text-to-Video Generation
items.summary: PhyRubric is a rubric-based diagnostic framework developed to evaluate the physical common sense compliance of text-to-video generation models. This system aims to provide a concrete analysis based on physical principles instead of the subjective scoring found in existing benchmarking methods.

snapshot.description: As text-to-video (T2V) models are increasingly positioned as world simulators, it is essential to evaluate whether their videos conform to physical commonsense. However, existing benchmarks rely on annotators who rate each video with a single score based on intuition, yielding ratings that are subjective and do not tell which physical principle is violated. We introduce PhyRubric, a rubric-grounded diagnostic framework for evaluating physical commonsense in T2V generation. For each caption, PhyR

items.title: DyCraft: An Agentic System for Long-Horizon 4D Scene Generation
items.summary: DyCraft is an agent-based system designed to create long-term and consistent 4D scene animations. Unlike traditional methods, it aims to produce more realistic and naturally moving objects by detecting and correcting physical errors.

snapshot.description: While frontier coding agents can generate high-quality 3D scenes and articulated assets, they struggle to create coherent long-horizon animations. When equipped with general-purpose harnesses, they frequently produce physically implausible outputs, generating objects that interpenetrate, lack physical support, or move unnaturally. items.title: From Tool State to Scientific Action: Auditing Decision Provenance in Biomedical Research Agents
items.summary: An article published on Hugging Face introduces a testing method called BioAgent-DF, which examines the evidence consistency in the decision-making processes of artificial intelligence agents used in biomedical research. The study shows that Qwen3.5-4B and Gemma 3 4B IT models can produce different citation and reading results on the same scientific data.

snapshot.description: A scientific agent can give the same verdict while reading and citing different evidence. BioAgent-DF tests this separation using paired reference and candidate values saved at the same scientific computation site. It restores or transplants those values at their original coordinates, then runs the agent on healthy hardware. Across eight SciFact batches, Qwen3.5-4B shows repeatable citation changes in three capture-claim combinations, and Gemma 3 4B IT shows repeatable read and citation changes

items.title: TorchCurves: Differentiable Parametric Curves
items.summary: TorchCurves is a PyTorch library that treats vector-valued parametric curves as learnable primitives. It allows curve coefficients to be optimized alongside other models using B-spline or Legendre polynomial bases.

snapshot.description: We present TorchCurves, a PyTorch library that treats vector-valued parametric curves as learnable primitives. Its central operation maps batches of scalar inputs to points on curves represented in B-spline or Legendre polynomial bases, with differentiation through both inputs and coefficients. Curve coefficients can be optimized jointly with the surrounding model or produced by another network. items.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Deleting Weights in LLM Post-Training
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face shows that new capabilities can be acquired by zeroing out less than 0.05% of the weights of large language models (LLMs). This method, called Deletion Tuning, allows achieving results similar to full fine-tuning by masking specific parameters instead of training the entire model.

snapshot.description: How little of a pretrained large language model (LLM) has to change for it to acquire new capabilities? We find that zeroing fewer than 0.05% of its weights, with no other modification, matches full fine-tuning (FFT) at scale across three LLM post-training regimes: reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, supervised fine-tuning, and on-policy distillation. Artificial intelligence models trained on massive amounts of data that can understand human language and generate text.
Technical skills and problem-solving abilities used in software development processes.
A text-based interface that runs programs using written commands instead of a mouse.
A structural hierarchy that allows content on web pages to be understood by screen readers and other assistive technologies.
Professionals who hold certification of expertise in financial planning and investment management.
A set of tools and libraries that facilitate the development of applications by software developers for a specific platform or system.
A measurement technology that creates a three-dimensional map of an object or area using laser beams.
Very small and economical commercial trucks produced according to Japanese standards.
Small motorized vehicles with side-by-side seating, generally designed for off-road use.
The process of creating meaningful texts in accordance with the given commands.
Technology capable of creating visual content based on written descriptions.
A method of making the user's short commands more detailed and descriptive to ensure the artificial intelligence provides better results.
An interface that allows different software to exchange data and communicate with each other.
An artificial intelligence capability that can process not only text but also different data types such as images or audio simultaneously.
A training method where artificial intelligence learns to make the most accurate decision through trial and error and the rewards it receives.
